messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Nova Retail sent over a SIG questionnaire and a few POC/pricing questions. Need security to own the intake and confirm what we can send to the customer. Attach: sig_v2.pdf (from sales).

tyler_soleng: I'll pick up the POC ops questions. Which env do they want for the POC?

maria_sales: They want a dedicated POC in us-west, 2x A100-ish, short 2-week eval. Also asked about SOC2 / data separation and whether we can sign a data processing addendum.

ajay_sec: Assigning to me for SIG review. Quick Qs: do they need answers for encryption keys management (KMS/HSM) and on-prem support? Also share the questionnaire link.

maria_sales: They flagged KMS and on-prem as 'maybe', DPA required. Link: https://files.novaretail.example/sig-12345 (customer link).

ajay_sec: Ok. Estimating 48h for initial answers. If there are any items needing engineering input I'll tag @tyler_soleng and @sarah_salesops. What is the go/no-go date?

maria_sales: Decision meeting with Nova scheduled 2/14. Need complete SIG + pricing notes by 2/10. Also they asked if we can provide cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted.

tyler_soleng: For POC, we can provision Hosted dedicated pool for 2 wks. Estimated cost calc: base infra + 2x A100 time. I'll DM numbers; need to confirm burst policy.

ajay_sec: Starting answers. Marking three high-priority control gaps to check: 1) MFA for service accounts? 2) Key rotation policy 3) Audit log retention. Anyone owns audit logs retention + export?

sarah_salesops: I'll confirm retention options and DPA template. Also we have a standard SOC2 report we can share under NDA.

sec-bot: Ticket RI-7892 created for SIG response. Assignee: ajay_sec. Due: 2439958800.

ajay_sec: First pass done for most items. Sticking points: they want HSM-backed key ownership — we can support customer-managed keys in Dedicated only. Will flag as a conditional requirement.

maria_sales: Noted. Can we get that in writing so I can escalate with pricing for Dedicated? They'll likely push for Hosted first.

ajay_sec: Will add this to the answers. Also need confirmation from infra about on-prem package timelines.

tyler_soleng: On-prem packaging is a stretch for this deal — timeline 3-4 months. Can offer a private VPC deployment in partner cloud earlier. I'll add to POC notes.

maria_sales: Ok pls add a short blurb for sales: 'Dedicated w/ customer KMS = supported; Hosted = bring-your-own encryption limited; On-prem = requires longer lead time.'

ajay_sec: Drafted response. Attaching snippet:

```
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated deployments. Hosted API supports envelope encryption; full HSM ownership requires Dedicated or On-prem.
Audit logs: Retention tiers: 30/90/365 days; export via S3 is available. SOC2: available under NDA.
```

Please review.

sarah_salesops: LGTM, just tweak 'Hosted' wording. Also confirm pricing delta for Dedicated KMS add-on (approx +25%).

tyler_soleng: Reviewed. POC ops: we'll provide a preconfigured docker image, sample prompts, and perf baseline. Need customer account contact to schedule provisioning window.

maria_sales: Contact is Liam at Nova (liam@novaretail.com). I'll ping him to schedule once we finalize answers. Also flagging for legal: DPA review.

legal_bot: DPA intake submitted (DL-556). Legal lead: @trisha_legal. ETA 72h.

trisha_legal: I'll review DPA and SOC2 NDA. Please attach customer's redlines if any.

maria_sales: No redlines yet. Liam said they'd send PII handling specifics tomorrow.

ajay_sec: Final answers ready except DPA confirmation. Posting final doc link: https://redwood.internal/sig-responses/RI-7892.pdf

maria_sales: Thanks team. I'll share to Nova once legal clears. Quick ask: @ajay_sec can you mark items that would trigger a price bump so I can include in proposal?

ajay_sec: Done — marked KMS/HSM and on-prem work as cost-driving. Updated doc.

tyler_soleng: I'll spin up POC infra once provisioning form is completed: https://redwood.internal/forms/poc-provision. I'll need contact + desired start date.

maria_sales: Sending start date options to Liam tonight. Will update thread when scheduled.

ajay_sec: Closing loop — SIG answers delivered to sales folder and ticket updated. Reopen if customer pushes more.

maria_sales: Appreciate it :tada:
